name: PS5 DevBridge
description: Native PS5 developer bridge by YAHBALLON for building and testing homebrew on a trusted local network. Background TCP 1337 service with live logs, ELF payload upload, file transfers, controller input automation, screenshots, browser launch, app lifecycle management, staged installation/update, package installer status and opt-in crash diagnostics. Includes a PS5 TV companion app. Requires a jailbroken/homebrew-capable console and existing ELF loader; the LAN service does not use authentication, so run it only on a trusted network.
author: YAHBALLON
